sprint-retrospective-template-samples.7: Tired of formats? Skip them and ask 3 well-chosen questions from the list below.
sprint-retrospective-template-samples.22: See how product teams turn [meeting minutes into Jira issues](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-minutes-to-jira), read our guide to faster [daily standup meetings](https://lynkk.ai/blog/daily-standup-meeting), and for more facilitation ideas, try [Parabol's retrospective techniques](https://www.parabol.co/resources/agile-sprint-retrospective-techniques/), a useful reference.
sprint-retrospective-template-samples.26: Once per sprint. It comes at the end, after the sprint review and before the next sprint planning, and closes out the sprint so the team can carry improvements straight into planning while details are still fresh. Retros held weeks later lose detail.
